## About this page

This page is a companion to the [Data Maker](data-maker.qmd) page. It
loads the CSV file that page produces (`airport_route_survey.csv`) and
prints the dataset to the page as a paginated, captioned table
(@tbl-survey) rather than one enormous block, using Quarto's `df-print:
paged` option.

## Load the data

```{python}
import pandas as pd

survey = pd.read_csv("airport_route_survey.csv")
```

## Display the full dataset

```{python}
#| label: tbl-survey
#| tbl-cap: "Airport route survey responses, all 300 rows."

survey
```
